party_size_guidance.note: advisory (validator warns; party sizes are not changed by the ordinary pass)

ai.skilled_route_trainer: expert where already supported; unchanged by this pass

transformation_rules.R1_evolution_sync: evolve to the unique plain level-evolution target when level >= threshold; devolve to the pre-evolution when level < the pre-evolution's threshold (thresholds read from live res/pokemon evolutions)
transformation_rules.R2_availability: species whose family earliest band is later than the trainer's band is replaced
transformation_rules.R3_duplicate: within-team repeated species are replaced (double battles exempt)
transformation_rules.R5_moves: explicit-move teams only: illegal or obviously weak (<=40 power, non-STAB, level>=28) moves are replaced by natural STAB attacks, <=2 slots per Pokémon

replacement_selection.types: share a type with the replaced species (Galactic grunts: Poison/Dark/Flying/Normal)
replacement_selection.stage: no evolution-stage contradiction at that level
replacement_selection.ranking: type affinity, then least-used (species + family), then BST proximity, then stable hash

excluded_from_ordinary_pass.reason: partner/story specials, boss records and unused/dummy records are not ordinary trainers

class_identity: preserved by the type-sharing rule; no competitive sets, no perfect coverage, held items and iv_scale unchanged
